text: “How vain it is to sit down to write when you have not stood up to live.”
Thoreau wrote this in his journal.
We often wait for the perfect idea
while the day goes by unlived.
What have you not yet stood up to live?
This is the thread behind the book *The 14-Day Clarity Reset*.
A short daily path from noise to clarity.

text: “If you want to improve, be content to be thought foolish and stupid.”
means being seen as a beginner.
at the cost of your growth.
Notice the sentence you tell yourself
as you would to a student.
you are not yet good at.
What would you try if looking foolish did not matter?
